node.name: User exports governed graph state
node.description: Registered user requests a snapshot of the current graph (nodes + edges) and receives it in Format-E v2 for offline analysis or import elsewhere.

node.name: Export graph state scenario
node.description: User triggers export → system serializes live graph to Format-E v2 and streams it back.

node.name: User sees live graph updates
node.description: Registered user opens the governed graph view and receives real-time push notifications for any mutation (add/update/delete) applied through the Apply-Gate.

node.name: Live update view scenario
node.description: User opens view → system establishes WebSocket connection and pushes mutation events as they occur.

node.name: User edits governed graph collaboratively
node.description: Registered user proposes a batch of mutations (add/update/delete) which is validated through the Apply-Gate; if accepted, changes are persisted and broadcast to all live viewers.

node.name: Collaborative edit scenario
node.description: User proposes batch → system validates via Apply-Gate; on success, mutations are applied and broadcast to all live viewers.

node.name: Export service
node.description: Background service that serializes the live graph to Format-E v2 and streams it back to requesting users.

node.name: Live update service
node.description: WebSocket-based service that pushes mutation events to all connected clients in real time.

node.name: Apply gate service
node.description: Validation and persistence layer that enforces governance rules on proposed mutations before applying them to the graph.
